handoff_payload:
# Analysis of Nike's Cost of Goods Sold as a Percentage of Revenue (FY2016-FY2018)

To calculate Nike's three-year average of cost of goods sold as a percentage of revenue, I will first compute the COGS-to-revenue ratio for each year, then average those ratios.

**FY2016:**
Cost of Sales ÷ Revenue = $17,405M ÷ $32,376M = 53.7%

**FY2017:**
Cost of Sales ÷ Revenue = $19,038M ÷ $34,350M = 55.4%

**FY2018:**
Cost of Sales ÷ Revenue = $20,441M ÷ $36,397M = 56.1%

**Three-Year Average:**
(53.7% + 55.4% + 56.1%) ÷ 3 = 165.2% ÷ 3 = **55.1%**

Nike's cost of goods sold represented approximately **55.1%** of revenue on average over the three-year period from FY2016 to FY2018, indicating a modest upward trend in the COGS ratio over this period.
